contract: Neutral complete-source review; human resolves current work and writes/promotes tasks.

must: Retain surviving invoice sending and the whole withdrawal in associated review context.
Original positive compound and later withdrawal are both literal source passages, without a current-task assertion.
Retain the complete inline withdrawal and independent sending undertaking.
Retain sending together with the full not-before, next-Friday and finance qualifier.
Retain BOTH genuine undertakings with their recorded speaker/timing; do not imply one owner.
Keep both original writing lines separate and unchanged; writing is excluded from model input.
Select no work groups from a question and affirmative availability answer.
Select no work groups from the price fact; preserve original writing separately without inventing a conflict.
Retain original compound work, later withdrawal and full later invoice timing/finance condition in associated context.
Retain the independent checklist undertaking with full next-week/after-approval condition and distinct attribution.
Avoid the twelve distractor turns and indiscriminate transcript selection.
Preserve both original writing lines separately; do not convert writing into speech.

critical: Missing a genuine independent spoken undertaking from the selected view.
Omitting or separating withdrawal/timing/condition context so the selected view materially misrepresents the associated work.
Misleading grouping that materially conflates undertakings/attribution or attaches a condition to unrelated work.
Changed source meaning, unsupported task/currentness/owner/deadline assertions, or writing attributed as speech.
Whole-transcript selection or generic warnings used to substitute for focused useful work coverage.
noncritical: Irrelevant fact/availability/unaccepted-request selection, redundant groups, unnecessary overlap or excessive context without a material meaning defect.
Record negative-control failures and review burden explicitly; they do not silently become passing criteria.
interpretation: Required references are source-based coverage anchors, not a demand to reproduce the authored group arrays exactly.
Judge grouping in actual rendered context; different useful groupings are allowed, with all necessary association and independent work retained.
Source integrity and schema validity cannot prove relevance, grouping, coverage or usefulness.
Selecting both original work and withdrawal is appropriate for neutral human review; it is not the old suggested-current-action contract.
The full transcript annex and generic notices cannot rescue omitted selected work.
One group with multiple complete turns is allowed if it does not imply one task or owner or materially obscure relationships.
stopping_rule: Chief assesses each saved valid rendered output before advancing; stop on first invalid output, identified critical selection defect, technical/identity/storage/deadline failure. No retry, resumption, replacement or unused-slot transfer.
limits: Seven familiar synthetic examples; longer input is Chief-authored, not held out.
One repetition; no reliability, saved effort, production/full-draft/full40/M10 acceptance or model-switch claim.
Prior results and grades remain unchanged.
